Airtel Postpaid Users to Get Apple Services Subscription

Airtel is offering its postpaid subscribers complimentary subscriptions to Apple TV+ and iCloud+. The offer also includes Apple Arcade. Eligibility for the offer depends on the specific Airtel postpaid plan.
